source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: a Set of attribute names (every name @emotion/is-prop-valid accepts) and checks for data-, aria- and x- attributes and event handlers, memoized with vemotion-memoize.

Adds 17 attributes of current HTML and SVG that React renders and the original rejected, so styled elements dropped them: command, commandFor, closedBy, part, exportParts, shadowRootMode, shadowRootDelegatesFocus, shadowRootClonable, shadowRootSerializable, imageSrcSet, imageSizes, noModule, blocking, precedence, transformOrigin, writingSuggestions and elementTiming. as stays excluded (styled's own prop).

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds and with React 16 and React 18.
